besluite.rede: 'Kry' in the sense of 'come across' (aantref) is standard, natural Afrikaans, so 'sien' is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: 'kyk met ... woorde' is not natural Afrikaans; one does not look with words.
besluite.rede: 'Jy gebruik steeds Graad 4 en 5 se woorde' says plainly what is meant without changing the content.

besluite.fout: 'wat net in blou geverf is' can attach to the dog rather than the picture, which makes a reader stumble.
besluite.rede: Splitting the sentence removes the ambiguity in two short Grade 6 sentences, with the same picture and the same facts.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: 'Die lug is ligblou' and 'die hond is blou' are two full sentences, so the AWS 2017 comma is required.

besluite.fout: 'deur ligter teenoor donkerder' has no noun or verb and reads as a fragment.
besluite.rede: The proposal completes the construction with the lesson's own word 'weergawes' and adds no content.

besluite.fout: 'Dit is nie regte gewig nie' is wooden; 'dit' has no clear referent.
besluite.rede: 'Dit gaan nie oor regte gewig nie' is the natural Afrikaans phrasing and keeps the point that the heaviness is only how it looks.

besluite.fout: The sentence compares how heavy the horse looks with his size itself, which is illogical.
besluite.rede: The proposal makes the comparison logical (with what his size leads you to expect) without adding any fact, and keeps 'lyk'.
